who_is_it_for.description: Who the group is for (optional rich text)

roles.description: Available roles within this group (e.g., Chair, Vice Chair, Member)

is_active.description: Whether this group is currently active

header_image_url.description: Optional header image URL displayed on the self-join browse page

allow_self_join.description: Whether members can join this group themselves from the Member Groups page

default_self_join_role.description: Role assigned automatically when a member self-joins this group

classification_id.description: Optional MemberGroupClassification this group belongs to (organisational label only, no behaviour)

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL for this group, shown as a link on the Member Group Detail page

terms_of_reference.description: Optional multi-line terms of reference shown to members when self-joining; the member must agree before the join completes

role_terms_of_reference.description: Deprecated. Previously held per-role terms-of-reference HTML, keyed by role name. Superseded by role_terms_url; retained for legacy data only.

role_terms_url.description: Optional per-role terms-of-reference URL, keyed by role name. Used by role invitations: the invite email and public invite page link to this URL. Roles without a URL show no terms link.

role_badge_ids.description: Optional per-role badge link, keyed by role name: badge id from the Badges module (badge table). Members currently holding the role see the badge in the Membership Badges section of /about-me; display is derived from current assignments, no member_badge rows are written.

role_term_definitions.description: Optional per-role term definition, keyed by role name: { term_value: number, term_unit: 'months'|'years', max_terms: number }. Surfaced (read-only) on vacancy postings and snapshotted onto assignments at award/invite-accept time.

events_enabled.description: Whether Group Admins of this group can create simple (single) events scoped to the group

complex_events_enabled.description: Whether Group Admins of this group can create complex (multi-session) events scoped to the group

resource_subcategories.description: Resource subcategory names linked to this group. The group's Resources card surfaces tenant resources tagged with any of these subcategories; group-created resources are auto-tagged with them; and such auto-tagged group resources become visible tenant-wide on /Resources under the matching filter.

self_join_closed.description: When true, the group remains visible on the Member Groups page but new self-join registrations are blocked. Use self_join_closed_label to customise the button text shown to members.

self_join_closed_label.description: Custom label shown on the disabled CTA button when self_join_closed is true. Defaults to 'Registrations closed' if left blank.

group_admins_can_edit_content.description: When true, Group Admins of this group may edit the header image and the description text fields (description, who_is_it_for, about_the_group) from the group detail page. Never grants name editing; enforced server-side on the generic entity PATCH.

automatic_membership_enabled.description: When true, members matching automatic_membership_filter_groups are automatically added to this group with the role automatic_membership_role.

automatic_membership_role.description: Role assigned to members added by automatic membership. Must be a value in the group's roles array. Required when automatic_membership_enabled is true.

automatic_membership_filter_groups.description: Filter groups (OR between groups, AND within each group) that define which members are automatically added. Each group has a conditions array.

allow_members_to_leave.description: When false, non-admin members may not self-remove from this group (enforced server-side on generic assignment DELETE).

automatic_membership_sync_status.description: Current sync state: idle | queued | running | error

automatic_membership_last_synced_at.description: Timestamp of last completed automatic membership sync.

automatic_membership_match_count.description: Number of members matched by the filter on the last completed sync.

automatic_membership_sync_error.description: Error message from the last failed sync, if any.

automatic_membership_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for resumable batch processing (null when idle/complete).

automatic_membership_generation.description: Monotonically-increasing generation counter incremented by a DB trigger whenever automatic_membership_enabled, automatic_membership_role, or automatic_membership_filter_groups changes. Used for stale-worker fencing in the reconcile RPC: a worker that reads a generation and later calls the RPC with that value will be rejected if the config has since changed.
